session.title: Enduro two-cycle race-bike transfer
session.purpose: Use the week's sole normal Enduro training exposure to transfer centred posture, braking timing and line speed from the Stumpjumper onto the race chassis without creating conference-week fatigue.

dose.admission_gate: Requires a fresh Friday Garmin sync, physical readiness not red, CNS ready or normal, clarity at least 8/10, normal vision and coordination, no illness or pain, clean response to Monday and no costly Thursday work.
dose.opening_gate: Easy warm-up plus figure-eights, dynamic loading, recentering and progressive stops on the unchanged race-bike system.
dose.cycle_one: Twin Peaks climb at RPE 4-5, then full Pure Quill at 75-80 percent with braking completed before turn-in and no feature attack.
dose.cycle_two_gate: Proceed only if vision, decision speed, front tracking and brake timing are clean; braking and upper-body fatigue are no more than 2/10; and there was no rescue, near miss or chassis concern.
dose.cycle_two: Repeat the climb at RPE 5 or lower and Pure Quill at 80-85 percent. Increase speed only through cleaner line memory, release and exit—not later braking or harder pedaling.
dose.hard_cap: Two complete cycles and familiar egress, 130 minutes maximum. No third stage, setup comparison, sprint, jump progression or race simulation.

session.adaptation_hypothesis: One deliberate weekly Enduro exposure is sufficient to retain race-bike mass, chassis, braking, cockpit and clipless automaticity while the Stumpjumper carries routine fitness volume.
execution_rules: Keep the currently selected Enduro shock, damping, tyres, pressures, cockpit and cleats unchanged.
Treat this as race-bike calibration through rider execution, not an equipment test.
Start fueled and use the canonical hot-MTB carbohydrate, fluid and sodium bands.

expected_result.technical: Cycle two matches or improves cycle one for vision, braking, front authority and dynamic centre with no extra arm pump.
expected_result.physiology: Climbs remain controlled and the session leaves no conference-day depletion.
expected_result.next_day: Normal cognition, upper body and legs during Saturday's conference.

stop_rules: No technical start if the admission or opening gate fails.
Stop after cycle one for delayed line choice, reactive braking, deflection, rescue, near miss, narrowed vision, arm pump above 2/10 or abnormal chassis behavior.
Thunder, lightning or unsafe grip requires immediate familiar egress.
Feeling excellent does not authorize a third cycle.
